title: Brambleway studio weekly sync
contextText: Weekly studio sync; plan summer cover.

segments.text: Morning both. Short one today, then I want five minutes on summer leave so we can plan cover.
Sounds good. Harbourline first? Their onboarding flows went into usability testing on Friday.
Yes, how did the first sessions go?
Mostly fine. People got lost on the account-linking step, which we half expected.
I saw the recordings. Three out of five participants skipped the linking screen completely.
Okay, so that screen needs a rethink before the next round.
Agreed. I'll send the Harbourline workshop agenda by Friday so we can walk them through it.
Great. And the workshop itself is in person?
It is. I'm flying to Rotterdam on Tuesday for the Harbourline workshop, back Wednesday night.
Take the prototype on the tablet, their wifi was terrible last time.
Will do. I'll load it offline.
Right, leave. Osric, you had something booked?
Yes. Mercer and I are finally taking the Lisbon trip we postponed last year.
Oh nice, when?
We fly out June 12 and come back June 20. It's the first holiday just the two of us since the kids.
Mercer's your wife, right? I met her at the studio party.
That's her. My wife has wanted to see Lisbon for about ten years, so no excuses this time.
Good for you both. So Osric is out June 12 to June 20. Sabin, anything from you?
Nothing big, just the Rotterdam day for work.
Okay. Osric, can you hand the Harbourline test notes to Sabin before you go?
Sure, I'll do a written handover the week before.
Perfect. That's everything, thanks both.

note.body:
# Brambleway studio weekly sync

**Date:** May 4
**Attendees:** Nico Sample, Osric Testcase, Sabin Stubbs

## Summary

Short internal sync at Brambleway Studio covering the first round of Harbourline usability testing, next week's client workshop, and summer leave so cover can be planned.

## Harbourline

- The onboarding flows went into usability testing on Friday. Participants struggled with the account-linking step: three out of five skipped the linking screen completely.
- The account-linking screen needs a rethink before the next round of testing.
- Sabin is flying to Rotterdam on Tuesday for the Harbourline workshop, back Wednesday night. This is a client work trip; he will take the prototype on a tablet with an offline build.

## Action items

- **Sabin Stubbs** — send the Harbourline workshop agenda by Friday.
- **Osric Testcase** — write a handover of the Harbourline test notes for Sabin the week before his leave.

## Leave and cover

- Osric and his wife Mercer are taking the Lisbon trip they postponed last year, flying out June 12 and returning June 20. It is their first holiday on their own since the kids were born.
- Osric is therefore out from June 12 to June 20, and Sabin covers Harbourline while he is away.
- No other leave was raised; Sabin's only time away is the Rotterdam day for work.

## Next steps

Nico will confirm the cover plan in the studio calendar, and the team reviews the reworked linking screen at the next sync before it goes back to Harbourline for a second round of testing.
